[[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] '''Uth Sulrowe''' was a [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] antiquities dealer who ran the [[Swain Import/Export Emporium]] in [[Cjaalysce'I]] on [[Socorro/Legends|Socorro]]. A shrewd dealer and businessbeing, Sulrowe sized up all customers who entered the Emporium. Sulrowe's intuition helped her in the Emporium's real business; selling [[Caelli-Merced Syndicate]] weapons and equipment. Her senses have more than once detected [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] operatives attempting to infiltrate [[Pret Swain]]'s operations.<ref name="BSS" />
